name: E-64
note: Classic irreversible epoxysuccinyl cysteine-protease inhibitor. Not ground truth for Xylellain -- a scale check only.

name: Leupeptin
note: Reversible peptide aldehyde, cysteine/serine protease inhibitor. Deposited as the gem-diol hydrate of the aldehyde warhead.

name: Cruzain vinyl-sulfone inhibitor (VS2)
note: From cruzain (Trypanosoma cruzi cysteine protease) co-crystal structure. Deposited SMILES is the reacted/saturated form (warhead alkene consumed by covalent addition), not the free pre-reaction vinyl sulfone.

name: Cathepsin K nitrile inhibitor (NOQ)
note: From a mutant rabbit cathepsin K co-crystal structure. Deposited SMILES is the isolated small-molecule component; the reactive nitrile carbon is covalently bonded to the catalytic Cys in the deposited complex and is not represented as C#N here.

name: SmCB1 azanitrile inhibitor (ORW)
note: From Schistosoma mansoni cathepsin B1 (SmCB1) co-crystal structure. Deposited SMILES is the isolated small-molecule component, same covalent-adduct caveat as Ref-04.
